# Marco Melucci

> Cybersecurity | Data Enthusiast

## About

Marco Melucci is an Italian cybersecurity professional and Security Transformation Analyst at Accenture.

His professional interests include OT/ICS Security, Automotive Cybersecurity, Cloud Security, Ethical Hacking and Cybersecurity Transformation.

- Data Analysis and Visualization
- IoT Security
